Locked-off camera, the exact same frame held for eight seconds, and it stays dark the whole time: the floodlights and stage lights stay off from start to end. Inside the darkness everything is restless: the dark outlines of heads in the near row shuffle and bob, a few arms rise as silhouettes, and the faint haze drifts slowly across the small green point on the far stage. The tiny green screen flickers slightly, like an old tube warming up. Sound: a low rumbling crowd building, whistles, stamping feet on the stands, no voices picked out, no music.
Thanks.
